guides.title: Attach and dispose the Node WebSocket runtime
guides.summary: Connect the process-local runtime to the host HTTP server after the framework fetch handler, preserve guarded upgrade checks, and await cleanup before shutdown.
guides.markdown:
# Run the Node adapter with an explicit lifecycle

`createNodeAdapter` handles only the framework's guarded `/ws/` upgrades. Keep ordinary HTTP handling on the framework's fetch handler, then pass that same handler to `runtime.attach(server, fetch)`. This ensures the framework runs middleware, origin checks, authorization and scope selection before the adapter accepts a socket. The adapter does not make WebSocket state durable or shared across Node processes.

Call `await runtime.dispose()` before closing an embedded server. Disposal detaches listeners, closes sockets and waits for active actions and component cleanup. Do not use the legacy `CossackNodeAdapter` when generating new applications; generated apps use `createNodeAdapter`.

For Vite development, import `cossackNode` from the separate `/vite` entry. It is a development integration, not the production server; production uses the generated Node entry and static asset server.

guides.title: Adapt SMTP with explicit delivery uncertainty
guides.summary: Adapt SMTP with explicit delivery uncertainty.
guides.markdown:
Wrap the existing createNodeEmailSender with createSmtpNotificationEmailProvider and pass private SMTP host/port/credentials through server configuration. The provider accepts the structural NodeEmailSender contract, copies declared message fields, and does not send during construction. Neither SMTP response acceptance nor a messageId proves final delivery. Provider idempotency is none: the runtime key is not sent as a fabricated SMTP guarantee.

Numeric SMTP 400-599 responseCode is an explicit rejection; 400-499 permits a safe runtime retry. Other thrown errors or malformed acceptance mean unknown. The adapter sends once and returns fixed redacted NotificationDeliveryError fields without transport messages/credentials. It rejects header injection and messages above its 256 KiB UTF-8 bound before I/O. Unknown outcomes must be reconciled, not blindly retried. Use a durable notification store for restart safety.

The executable example injects a structural sender and sends no mail. The separate real loopback SMTP acceptance covers preview without network, preaccept450 rejection/retry, exactly one DATA for the accepted operation, duplicate suppression and ambiguous post-DATA socket failure with SQLite restart/no resend. It uses no external account or email. See docs/notification-providers.md.
